text: Independent re-review: this product-ux session is not the author (team-lead); read-only, no edits, no git writes, no deploy.
empty now disables the search field (searchDisabled includes empty) with native disabled + aria-disabled=true + aria-describedby=notes-empty, matching web/app.js searchBlocked(notes.length===0).

Accepted product residual, re-rated minor. Offline search stays disabled per spec §3.3 with aria-disabled + aria-describedby + offline placeholder; the copy overstates a network dependency for a client-side filter (AOD-2). Bounded to the transient offline state; tracked for s22e.
Prototype per-row delete is disabled via formDisabled in loading/error/offline/offline-zero and active in idle/results; product-code parity tracked for s22a/s22e.

?state=offline-zero renders «Нет сети — нет загруженных заметок.» + base empty message, disabled search, hidden count/list/clear. 8 states x 2 viewports = 16 exports; proto.json and state-matrix describe it.
«Проверить сеть» now simulates a successful re-check by returning to idle instead of reloading the same offline URL. The still-offline branch is not simulated (acceptable for a state prototype).
Clear -> idle, Retry -> idle, per-row delete removes the row and updates the results count, offline-check -> idle. Remaining focus/Add/Logout inertness is accepted as a state-prototype limitation.
Error region is role=alert aria-live=polite, matching spec §3.2 and web/index.html.

Active artifacts are on DS 1.0.1 (state-matrix, proto.json, design-impact, ds-pin/ds-lock/refs, digest 4e0ef105…); spec/core.md and visualized-brief.md remain historical 1.0.0 snapshots. 1.0.1's only CSS delta is an explicit body font-size, so there is no visual drift.

text: Accepted GAP-2 residual for DS 1.x: disabled search has no visual disabled treatment (only button:disabled is styled); the pixel comparison confirms the empty export is visually unchanged after disabling.
Offline banner stays a .note-item card with an interactive button inside role=status; reads like another note row and wraps a control in a live region. Recovery CTA is clear; no local CSS.
At 390 the clear control is a separate full-width 44px block under the field (stacked .notes-search-row), detached from the query and as heavy as the composer action; label-in-name passes.
Accepted minor, now recorded: state-matrix notes the prototype label/placeholder divergence from web/index.html and drops the no-autofocus claim.

Verified count semantics (Найдено 2 / 0, hidden on empty query, polite live region); classes exist in web/app.css 1.0.1 with no local CSS; offline copy avoids a persistence promise; language split follows AOD-6; 16 exports cover 8 states. v6 comparison: 10/14 unchanged; 2 empty frames differ by 2 px at delta 1; 2 offline frames differ as intended (disabled deletes + banner spacing).
Deleting the last visible match in results now goes to no-results (not empty), matching state-matrix and web/app.js renderNotes.
offline-zero shows «Добавьте первую выше» while Add is offline-disabled; accepted copy residual mirroring current app behavior (offline banner + notes-empty, form disabled), tracked for s22a.
The composer textarea is now disabled in loading/error/offline/offline-zero (noteText.disabled = formDisabled), matching web/app.js syncFormState.

State-per-render limitation: the search input is not live-wired in the static prototype (typing does not filter); web/app.js implements live filtering. Recorded in state-matrix so the query->results step is not read as a live interaction.
